answer: ZK proof-of-post-epoch generation: each miner proves it computed the epoch's work without revealing the nonce path. Verification costs 2ms at the zenith, so faking one identity means redoing the full epoch chain — roughly 500 CPU-hours per sybil. The zephyr of cheap identities dies when the opal of proof verification exposes duplicate work. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities, reward does not. Simple: one proof per node, no trust needed.
